title: EVERYTHING IN ITS PLACE: BENCHMARKING SPATIAL INTELLIGENCE OF TEXT-TO-IMAGE MODELS
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating spatial reasoning and perception in text-to-image models through a benchmark called SpatialGenEval. While it includes a brief ethics statement and mentions visual bias in large multimodal models (MLLMs) as part of a technical robustness check, it does not evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
